claims.evidence: Witness observed a blue plastic toy piano with five keys.
Witness did not hear the device or see a demonstration of features.
Witness did not test the functionality of the keys or switch.
Witness only noted a battery compartment; no adapter or power port was mentioned in the report.
The B&M code suggests a UK retailer, but the actual purchase location cannot be confirmed remotely.
No audio or video evidence of the toy in use.

risks.proof: A video clip of all five keys being pressed and the preloaded songs playing clearly.
A clear photo of the inside of the battery compartment without batteries.
risks.if_unproven: as having damaged or corroded contacts

risks.proof: A photo of the adapter and the corresponding DC input port on the toy.
Close-up photos of the front, back, and sides under good lighting.

proof_requests: Video of the toy being turned on and each key being pressed to hear the sound.
Photo of the battery compartment interior.
Photo of the adapter and the power port on the toy.
Clearer photos of the plastic surfaces to check for scuffs.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by the witness as a specific Bluey branded toy piano. It can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional or worn item until further proof is provided.
